description:
x-kv: a distributed transactional KV store. v2 rewrite — proto / api /
        protocol layers redesigned against TiKV v8.x. Built on x-raft-lib for
        Raft, RocksDB for storage, gRPC for transport.

        Modules:
          - proto:   gRPC + protobuf wire definitions
          - pd:      Placement Driver (cluster metadata, TSO, scheduler)
          - kv:      Multi-Raft KV store with MVCC + Percolator
          - client:  PD-aware Java SDK (raw KV + transactional)
          - tests:   integration / chaos / linearizability / benchmark suite
